testOnly.activity_census: read by tests of the activity count
testOnly.append_section_history_at: history writer with a fixed clock, for tests
testOnly.apply_sections_with_cache: detection entry point exercised by tests
testOnly.estimate_offline_range: offline range estimate read by tests
testOnly.get_ftp_trend: FTP trend as of today, read by the screen-bundle tests the summary card is compared against
testOnly.get_merge_candidates: merge candidate query read by tests
testOnly.get_section_calendar_summary: calendar read the screen-bundle tests compare the screen read against
testOnly.get_section_chart_data: chart read the screen-bundle tests compare the screen read against
testOnly.get_sections_filtered: filtered section query read by tests
testOnly.get_stale_ranked_sections: stale section query read by tests and a bench

noCallers.compute_hrv_trend: called by a bench only; the screen read uses the pooled trend
noCallers.latest_ramp_rate: no caller; the screen read uses latest_ramp_rate_to
